span.p:
Price every ticker held or targeted
total = sum of quantity x price over holdings

span.p:
targetValue = total x target% / 100
(ticker not in target: 0%)
gap = targetValue - currentValue

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
SELL round-to-nearest(-gap / price) shares
proceeds += sale value
(0 shares: no order)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
shares = min( floor(gap / price), floor(budget / price) )
budget starts at proceeds, minus each buy

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Plan = sells + buys
buys never exceed sale proceeds
